data.name: Jazeel
data.gender_notes: Jazeel is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic language, 'Jazeel' means 'gentle, kind and powerful' in its true essence. It is a name that signifies strength, compassion, and courage. This name is perfect for a child who is destined to make a difference in the world with his gentle yet powerful personality. The name Jazeel carries the meaning “Powerful, Soft, Gentle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Jazeel usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, soft, gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic numerology, the name Jazeel holds a deep spiritual significance. It is said that the name resonates with the number 3, which is symbolic of creativity, self-expression, and growth. It is believed that individuals with the name Jazeel possess the ability to tap into their inner creativity and express themselves in unique and powerful ways.
data.etymology: Jazeel belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, Soft, Gentle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jazeel total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: جَزيل
in_arabic.meaning: جَزيل يعني الكثير الجميل الغني بالخيرات
in_arabic.long_meaning: جَزيل هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه الكثير الجميل الغني بالخيرات. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفرقان آية 57: وَيَقْبَلُ الصَّلَاةَ أُولَٰئِكَ عَلَيْهِمُ صَلَوَاتٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِم وَرَحْمَةٌ وَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُهْتَدُونَ. والجَزيل من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني الخصال الحميدة والتميّز في الخير والجمال.

in_urdu.name: جزیل
in_urdu.meaning: جزیل مطلب ہے خوبصورت، وافر، غنی
in_urdu.long_meaning: جزیل ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت، وافر، غنی۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں بھی آیا ہے جہاں اس کا اشتقاق 'جزل' سے ہوا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورتی، فراوانی۔ اسلامی تقالید میں اس نام کو اچھے خصال اور خوبصورتی کے معنی میں استعمال کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जज़ील
in_hindi.meaning: जज़ील का अर्थ है सुंदर, अधिक, समृद्ध
in_hindi.long_meaning: जज़ील एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है सुंदर, अधिक, समृद्ध। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में अच्छे गुणों और सुंदरता के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है। अरबी मूल में 'जज़ल' से निकला है जिसका अर्थ है सुंदरता, समृद्धि।

in_pashto.name: جزیل
in_pashto.meaning: جزیل د ښکلي، ډیر، بډیچ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: جزیل یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دا د ښکلي، ډیر، بډیچ معنی لري. دا نوم د اسلامي دودیزو کې د ښو ځانګړتیاوو او ښکلا په مانا کارول کیږي. دا د 'جزل' څخه اخیستل شوی چې د ښکلا، کثرت معنی لري.

historical_references.reference: The city of Jazan (Jazeel) was an important Yemeni port city, dating back to ancient times. It was a significant trading center for frankincense and myrrh, as well as a strategic military location due to its position on the Red Sea.
historical_references.time_period: Ancient Yemen, around 1st millennium BC - 6th century AD
historical_references.context: Jazan was part of the Kingdom of Saba, a major civilization in ancient Yemen. It was also a key city in the trade network that connected Yemen to Egypt, Greece, and Rome.

historical_references.reference: Islam's Prophet Muhammad dispatched an expedition, known as the Expedition of Jazeerah, in 630 AD to protect Muslim interests in the region from Byzantine and Roman threats. This military campaign marked an important step in the expansion of the Islamic state in the Arabian Peninsula.
historical_references.context: The Expedition of Jazeerah, led by Muslim military commander Al-Ala' ibn al-Hadrami, was launched from Medina and involved a fleet of ships and land forces. The campaign resulted in the establishment of Muslim control over key ports and territories in the Red Sea region, including Jazeerah.
